channel.title: The Car Jury, News
channel.description: News and verdicts on the Indian car market from The Car Jury.

item.title: Hyundai India Cracks 75k in a Month: Record July on Creta and Exports
item.description: Hyundai India posted its highest-ever monthly sales in July 2026 at 75,360 units, with domestic dispatches up 23% year-on-year.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: 2026 Scorpio N Spied At Dealer With Pano Sunroof: August 15 Launch Locked
item.description: 2026 Mahindra Scorpio N spotted at a dealer yard with panoramic sunroof, 10.2-inch screens and Sony audio, ahead of an August 15 launch.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: Hyundai's Bayon-based sub-Creta SUV lands this festive season, and it needs to undercut the Venue

item.title: MoRTH drafts safety and fitness rules for two-wheeled ambulances
item.description: MoRTH proposes fitness inspections, warning-light standards and AIS:209 compliance for two-wheeled road ambulances, with phased deadlines through 2027.
